extDescription.message: Finds the videos on a page and lets you download them in the resolution you choose.

waitingForVideo.message: Waiting for the video to start loading. If nothing changes, press play.

failTitle.message: The video was found but could not be read

failHttp.message: The video server refused the request (HTTP $1). The link may have expired: press play and then “Try again”.

failNetwork.message: Could not connect to the video server.

failOpaque.message: The video playlist is not standard HLS or DASH: the platform delivers it encrypted or in its own format. video-down does not break platform protections.

failHtml.message: The server returned a web page instead of the video playlist. This usually happens when the link has expired or the session is not valid.

failJson.message: The server returned data (JSON) instead of the video playlist.

failOther.message: The response is not a standard HLS or DASH video playlist.

optVersionMismatch.message: The extension is $1 and the native component is $2. Run the installer for version $1 and reload the extension in chrome://extensions.

retryingNative.message: The browser could not build the video; retrying with the native component (yt-dlp)…

otherListsFailed.message: Other video playlists on this page could not be read ($1). They may have more qualities:

nativeUnsupported.message: The video of this player was not found and yt-dlp does not recognise the page. Press play, wait a few seconds and press “Try again”.

nativeFailed.message: The native component could not read this video.

viaNative.message: It will be downloaded by the native component (yt-dlp).

downloadFailed.message: The download could not be started.

drmBody.message: This video uses copy protection. video-down does not download it: that would require circumventing the protection, which the law does not allow even if you hold rights to the content.

drmHint.message: If you are the rights holder, download the original from the platform or ask the distributor for the file.

liveBody.message: This version does not record live streams. Once it ends and is saved, you can download it.

needNativeYoutube.message: YouTube can only be downloaded with the native component (yt-dlp), installed by the video-down installer for Windows or Mac.

needNativeStream.message: This player uses its own format, which the browser cannot rebuild. The native component (yt-dlp) can download it.

nativeMissing.message: The native component is not installed or does not respond.

popupEmpty.message: Open a page with a video and press the icon in its top-left corner.

optHow1.message: Open a page with a video. A download icon appears in its top-left corner.

optHow2.message: Press the icon and pick one of the available resolutions.

optHow3.message: The download starts right away. Progress shows in the menu itself and on the video-down icon in Chrome's toolbar.

optHowRoutes.message: Plain files, HLS and DASH are downloaded inside the browser. YouTube, players with their own format and videos above 1.5 GB go to the native component (yt-dlp) when it is installed.

optNativeWhy.message: A small program installed on Windows or Mac together with yt-dlp, ffmpeg and Deno. The extension only uses it when the browser is not enough.

optWin1.message: Run “video-down-setup.exe” and follow the wizard. It installs the native component and puts the extension in its folder.

optWin2.message: When it finishes, chrome://extensions opens. Turn on “Developer mode”, press “Load unpacked” and choose the folder the installer shows.

optWin3.message: Come back to this page and press “Check again”. The status should change to “Native component active”.

optMac1.message: Unzip the macOS package and double-click “Instalar video-down.command”. If macOS blocks it, right-click it and choose “Open”.

optMac2.message: When it finishes, chrome://extensions opens. Turn on “Developer mode”, press “Load unpacked” and choose the folder the installer shows.

optMac3.message: Come back to this page and press “Check again”. The status should change to “Native component active”.

optAskWhere.message: Ask where to save each browser download

optShowOverlay.message: Show the download icon over videos

optNotify.message: Show a notification when a download finishes

optMinWidth.message: Minimum video width to show the icon (px)

optConcurrency.message: Segments downloaded at the same time (HLS and DASH)

optNativeAbove.message: Hand videos larger than this to the native component (MB)

optLegal1.message: Only download videos you hold rights to or whose licence allows it. You decide what you download and you are responsible for it.

optLegal2.message: video-down does not download DRM-protected content and does not circumvent any technical protection measure.

optCredits.message: Based on Media Bridge (MIT). Uses yt-dlp (Unlicense), FFmpeg (LGPL/GPL) and Deno (MIT).
